clauses.quote: Teachers returning from a sabbatical leave will be entitled at the end of the leave to the position they left, or to a position comparable to the one vacated.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers returning from a sabbatical leave

clauses.quote: The teacher hired as a replacement shall be notified in writing at the time of appointment that the appointment is for the length of the regular teacher's leave only.
clauses.subject_text: The teacher hired as a replacement

clauses.quote: Teachers in the District are eligible to apply for a leave of absence without pay.
One-year leaves of absence without pay shall be granted for reasons of newborn care or adoption.
clauses.subject_text: One-year leaves of absence without pay

clauses.quote: A limited number of leaves of absence without pay for other reasons (including but not limited to health problems and graduate work at a university) may also be granted by the Superintendent after consultation with the principal and with approval of the Board.
clauses.subject_text: A limited number of leaves of absence without pay for other reasons (including but not limited to health problems and graduate work at a university)

clauses.quote: Teachers shall submit a written request stating the purpose of the leave, the length of the leave, and the beginning and termination dates.
One-year leaves of absence without pay may not exceed two full semesters.
clauses.subject_text: One-year leaves of absence without pay

clauses.quote: Insurance benefits will not be provided for teachers on a one-year leave of absence without pay.
Teachers returning from a leave of absence without pay will be entitled at the end of the leave to the position they left, or to a position comparable to the one vacated.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers returning from a leave of absence without pay

clauses.quote: The teacher hired as a replacement shall be notified in writing at the time of appointment that the appointment is for the length of the regular teacher's leave only.
clauses.subject_text: The teacher hired as a replacement

clauses.quote: To facilitate staffing and assignments, teachers returning from a leave of absence without pay are entitled to return to work at the beginning of the semester (for secondary) or beginning of a school year (for elementary) which most closely follows the anniversary of the beginning of the leave.
clauses.subject_text: teachers returning from a leave of absence without pay

clauses.quote: Teachers scheduled to return at the beginning of the first semester (secondary) or beginning of the school year (elementary) must notify the Human Resources office, in writing, of their intent to return no later than March 1.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers scheduled to return at the beginning of the first semester (secondary) or beginning of the school year (elementary)

clauses.quote: Teachers scheduled to return at the beginning of the second semester (secondary) must notify the Human Resources office of their intent to return in writing no later than November 1.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers scheduled to return at the beginning of the second semester (secondary)

clauses.quote: Upon returning from a one-year leaves of absence without pay, the teacher will resume contract status as a contract teacher.
